name: Santa Fe de Antioquia (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Santa Fe de Antioquia (a tree above waves with a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Fe de Antioquia, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Santa Fe de Antioquia arms — tree above waves with a lion
